# Rendering environment the baselines in this directory were
# recorded in. visual_regression.py compares it against the local
# machine before it compares any page, because an ink-density
# signature belongs to a font and rasteriser stack as much as to a
# design. Do not edit by hand: re-record with
#   python3 tests/visual_regression.py --approve --rebase-environment
engine	pdfTeX 3.141592653-2.6-1.40.25 (TeX Live 2023/Debian)
raster	pdftoppm version 24.02.0
grid	48
dpi	72
tolerance	6
